## Working in `libs/theme`

- `BrandThemeService` is the single source of truth for active brand + scheme; it
  mirrors state onto `<html>` and persists to `localStorage`. A visitor's saved
  choice always wins over `provideBrandTheme({ brand })` defaults.
- `brand.types.ts` and `brand-theme.config.ts` are dependency-light on purpose —
  keep `@angular/core` as the only import there.
- `ng-zorro-tokens.css` re-points the ng-zorro classes the design system exposes
  (`.ant-select`, `.ant-table`, `.ant-btn-*`, pagination, popovers) at `--ds-*`
  so raw ng-zorro also follows a brand switch. Add a rule here when you surface a
  new ng-zorro widget.
- `nx run theme:styles` compiles `generated/antd.css` + `generated/antd-dark.css`
  via `build-antd-theme.mjs` (needs `less` with `javascriptEnabled`).
